{{Top|leg}}
A '''transponder mask''' was a custom [[Starship/Legends|starship]] modification installed aboard [[Sythluss Leethe]]'s [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']]. It was capable of switching the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]] to broadcast a different signal. Both signals were entered into the records of the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], rendering them both "legal." Using this system, ''The Maker'' could use an alternate code that identified it as ''One Shot''.<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
